description: 你的随身 AI 剪辑搭档 | Pocket AI co-editor for video montage — AI video editing plugin & MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Hermes & OpenCode

tool_signatures.name: cassette_answer_question
tool_signatures.description: Classify a Cassette question using question mode, or resume an interrupted job using validated job_id and response fields.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_cancel_job
tool_signatures.description: Request cooperative cancellation of a persisted Cassette job.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_config
tool_signatures.description: On-demand model picker for the session. Call only when the user asks to view or change the Cassette model. With only session_id it returns the current choice and available options; pass model (id or label) and/or thinking_level to change them. The choice persists for the session and applies from the next cassette_run_job turn. Default: GPT-5.6 Luna with xhigh thinking.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_edit
tool_signatures.description: Surgical no-LLM timeline edit through the manual-editor command lane (requires CASSETTE_DIRECT_EDIT=1). Use for small named changes (trim, text, delete, undo) after reading cassette_timeline; big or creative briefs go through cassette_run_job. input is always {"payload": {...}}. Pass expected_version from the last timeline read; tool_name 'undo' with input.cursorSequence rewinds the shared operation history.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_ingest_media
tool_signatures.description: Ingest a trusted local media file from the active host project or an explicitly configured media root. Generates a cryptographically random session_id when omitted.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_jamendo_setup
tool_signatures.description: Validate and privately store this machine's own Jamendo Client ID for read-only music matching. Before calling, explain that the user creates a read-only application at https://devportal.jamendo.com/, no Client Secret is needed, and pasting the Client ID places it in the conversation transcript. Ask for their Client ID; never invent one and never ask for a Client Secret. A failed validation preserves existing configuration.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_job_status
tool_signatures.description: Re-attach to a job whose cassette_run_job call did not return — host restart, cancellation, or a turn deliberately started with wait=false. Call it once and act on the phase; it is not a progress loop. wait_for_change_sec gives an unsettled job up to 30 seconds to reach its next phase before answering.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_list_assets
tool_signatures.description: List media assets isolated to one Cassette session.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_login
tool_signatures.description: Sign this machine in to Cassette, or have a replacement password emailed. Pass email plus the generated password from the user's Cassette email. Cassette passwords are always server-generated, never chosen — ask the user for theirs, never invent one. If they no longer have it, confirm with them first, then pass request_new_password=true with confirm_replace=true: that replaces the account password on every machine they use and emails a new one. Credentials are verified before anything is written, so a wrong password leaves an existing working setup untouched.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_make_prompt
tool_signatures.description: Build a complete Cassette edit prompt from a natural-language instruction and session assets.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_match_bgm
tool_signatures.description: Match and optionally register a Free To Use background-music asset for a session.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_match_exact_bgm
tool_signatures.description: Match an exact song and artist, optionally download it, and register it with the session.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_review_completion
tool_signatures.description: Resolve a review-required completion. Rendering starts only for an explicit, validated decision=export. For a cassette_run_job(export=true) triggered by the user's explicit export request, review the attached timeline and call this immediately in the same assistant turn; do not ask the user to authorize export again merely because the Cassette agent's prose claims rendering is unavailable.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_run_job
tool_signatures.description: Run one Cassette edit turn and return when it is settled. This call IS the wait: it streams progress notifications while the agent works and answers with the terminal envelope (succeeded / needs_user / review_required / exported / failed). Pass message as the user's words verbatim. Exactly one cassette_run_job call per user turn: after any settled result, return control to the user. Never start a corrective, retry, or follow-up run in the same user turn, even if you think the edit could be improved. Do not poll cassette_job_status after a settled result; that tool is only for resuming a job whose call was interrupted. Pass wait=false only to deliberately detach the turn into the background. If an explicit export request returns phase=review_required, the user has already authorized export: inspect the attached timeline and call cassette_review_completion in this same assistant turn. Do not ask for redundant confirmation, and do not start another cassette_run_job.

tool_signatures.name: cassette_timeline
tool_signatures.description: Read the live Cassette timeline as a bounded text digest (CTL). Call this before any statement about project state — never answer from memory. contact_sheet=true also tiles the stored clip posters into one image (zero render) and saves it locally. Present the returned contact_sheet_uri as the thumbnail link. In Hermes TUI, label it as saved locally and output MEDIA:<contact_sheet_uri> on its own line; use the URL-encoded URI, never the raw contact_sheet_path, because raw paths may contain spaces.

tool_signatures.name: jamendo_music_matcher
tool_signatures.description: Search Jamendo with validated fixed-form music preferences and optionally register a result.
